featured.title: Apple opens Foundation Models to developers free at WWDC 2026
featured.excerpt: At WWDC 2026 Apple opened its Foundation Models framework: free on-device and Private Cloud Compute access, image input, and third-party model calls through Swift.
featured.tldr: At its 2026 Platforms State of the Union, Apple removed the cost barrier to building AI features on its platforms. Developers with fewer than two million first-time App Store downloads get free access to Apple Foundation Models on Private Cloud Compute, plus image input, server-side model calls, and a new multi-agent Dynamic Profiles system. Apple also confirmed the framework goes open source later this summer.

latest.title: Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK brings MCP and sub-agents to TypeScript and Python
latest.excerpt: Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK gives developers a TypeScript and Python toolchain that wires native Model Context Protocol servers and sub-agents directly into Claude.
latest.tldr: Anthropic introduced the Claude Agent SDK, a TypeScript and Python toolchain for building agents on Claude Sonnet and Opus. It integrates native Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and sub-agents directly, giving teams a supported path to multi-tool, multi-step agents instead of hand-rolled glue code.

latest.title: OpenAI models and Codex now run on Oracle Universal Credits
latest.excerpt: OpenAI says Oracle Cloud Infrastructure customers can now access its frontier models and Codex through existing Oracle Universal Credits, skipping separate procurement.
latest.tldr: OpenAI announced on June 11 that Oracle Cloud Infrastructure customers can access its frontier models and Codex through their existing Oracle Universal Credits. The deal lets enterprises deploy OpenAI technology without opening a separate procurement channel, folding AI spend into a contract they already have.

latest.title: OpenAI ships three real-time audio models for voice agents
latest.excerpt: OpenAI launched three real-time audio models aimed at conversational agents, live translation, and transcription, pushing voice from a feature toward core infrastructure.
latest.tldr: OpenAI released three real-time audio models targeting conversational agents, translation, and transcription. The split into purpose-built models signals that voice is being treated as production infrastructure for agents rather than a single bolt-on speech feature.

latest.title: Gemini 3.5 Pro still not GA a month after Google's I/O promise
latest.excerpt: Google teased Gemini 3.5 Pro at I/O and said "give us until next month." As of mid-June it is still in limited preview, even as Gemini 3.5 Flash went generally available.
latest.tldr: Google previewed Gemini 3.5 Pro at I/O on May 19 with a two-million-token context window and a Deep Think reasoning mode, telling developers to wait about a month. As of mid-June it remains in limited Vertex AI preview rather than general availability, while the cheaper Gemini 3.5 Flash already shipped to GA and became the default in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search.
